<a id="page-data"></a>
# Data (feature layer)

The data layer: HTTP APIs, cloud documents and files, storage on the device, and form submission. Open it when a UI loads or saves data beyond its own state. Its words and actions are allowed only where the host enables the layer (see [levels.md](levels.md)).

<a id="data-actions"></a>
## Actions

Written in an event as their type and fields by name, as on [events.md](events.md#events-actions).

<a id="action-callApi"></a>
### `callApi`: Call API

Calls API `api` (the publish model's `services.apis`) with `params`, its inputs (expressions; an empty one takes the input's default). Then `onSuccess` runs after a 2xx response, `onError` after any other or a failed request, both reading the response as `${result}`. A failed request without `onError` stops the chain.

Written `callApi api=… params=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api` | text | `""` | An API of services.apis. |
| `params` | JSON |  | Its inputs, by name (expressions). |
| `onSuccess` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run after a 2xx response. |
| `onError` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run after a failure. |

<a id="action-setStorage"></a>
### `setStorage`: Set storage

Changes the app's values on the device (read as `${storage.<key>}`). A key may be a path (`prefs.theme`) into a stored map or list.

Written `setStorage operation=… key=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | `write` `remove` `clear` | `write` |  |
| `key` | text | `""` | The key; may be a path. Not for clear. |
| `valueType` | [VariableType](values.md#enum-VariableType) | `text` | How the written value is read (write only). |
| `op` | [WriteOp](values.md#enum-WriteOp) | `set` | How the value changes. |
| `value` | text | `""` | The value (an expression); not for toggle, removeAt. |
| `index` | text | `""` | A list index (an expression). |
| `mapKey` | text | `""` | A map key (an expression). |
| `skipIfExists` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Leaves a key that has a value. |

<a id="action-cloudDocuments"></a>
### `cloudDocuments`: Cloud documents

Writes documents of a cloud collection: one at a time by id, or many at once.

Written `cloudDocuments operation=… path=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | `add` `update` `remove` `removeMany` `setMany` | `add` |  |
| `path` | text | `""` | The collection path (an expression). |
| `id` | text | `""` | The document id (an expression). |
| `autoId` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Add: a generated id. |
| `skipIfExists` | `true`/`false` | `true` | Add only. |
| `document` | text | `""` | The document (add) or documents (setMany): an expression, or JSON text. |
| `raw` | `true`/`false` | `false` | The document is taken as written: no expressions. |
| `field` | text | `""` | Update: the field (a path). |
| `valueType` | [VariableType](values.md#enum-VariableType) | `text` | Update only. |
| `op` | [WriteOp](values.md#enum-WriteOp) | `set` | How the value changes. |
| `value` | text | `""` | The value (an expression); not for toggle, removeAt. |
| `index` | text | `""` | A list index (an expression). |
| `mapKey` | text | `""` | A map key (an expression). |
| `ids` | text | `""` | RemoveMany: ids, comma separated or a list. |
| `whereFilters` | JSON |  | RemoveMany: the filters. |
| `idField` | text | `"id"` |  |
| `merge` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |
| `replaceCollection` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |

<a id="action-loadCloudData"></a>
### `loadCloudData`: Load cloud data

Streams a cloud document, or a collection query's documents, into variable `variable` while the screen shows: `{status: loading|loaded| error, isLoading, data, error, hasMore}`. A variable of type list gets the documents themselves, and with an `aggregate`, a number variable the number. Blocking actions wait for the first value; an initial failure stops the chain. A later subscription failure stops any remaining actions from that invocation and fires the canvas's actionError reaction. Subscriptions close on error or when the screen is disposed.

Written `loadCloudData variable=… single=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | text | `""` |  |
| `single` | `true`/`false` | `true` | One document, or the query's documents. |
| `id` | text | `""` |  |
| `query` | JSON |  | The collection and, for a query, its filters, sorts, limit and joins (a CloudQueryDef). |
| `scope` | `screen` `app` | `screen` | Screen: a subscription per screen, until it goes. App: one subscription the whole app shares, into an app variable every screen reads. |
| `limit` | text | `""` | The most documents: a number or expression; empty: the query's, else 500; 0: all. |
| `aggregate` | `none` `count` `sum` `average` | `none` | A number (count, sum, average) instead of the documents, without loading them. |
| `aggregateField` | text | `""` | Sum and average: the field. |
| `refreshSeconds` | whole number (≥ 0) | `0` | Aggregate: also runs again this often (writes made elsewhere); 0: after this app's writes only. |
| `reactive` | `true`/`false` | `true` | Runs again when a value its query reads changes (${auth.uid}, a bound limit). |

<a id="action-reloadCloudData"></a>
### `reloadCloudData`: Reload cloud data

Runs again the live load of `variable` (a `LoadCloudDataAction` that ran on this screen): it subscribes afresh, with the values its query reads now, and waits for the first value. Nothing when the variable has no load. A list's pull to refresh (its `refresh` reaction) runs it.

Written `reloadCloudData variable=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | text | `""` | A variable a load cloud data action fills. |

<a id="action-cloudFiles"></a>
### `cloudFiles`: Cloud files

Uploads files the user picks to (or deletes them from) cloud storage folder `path`; `actions` run with each file (`${result.url}`...). With a `source`, it uploads that value instead of asking the user (a captured screenshot, a drawing).

Written `cloudFiles operation=… path=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | `upload` `delete` | `upload` |  |
| `path` | text | `""` | The storage folder. |
| `kind` | `image` `any` | `image` |  |
| `allowMultiple` | `true`/`false` | `true` |  |
| `maxSizeMB` | number | `10` |  |
| `progressVariable` | text | `""` |  |
| `access` | `public` `private` | `public` |  |
| `source` | text | `""` | Uploads this instead of asking the user: a data: URL (${result.image} of a screenshot), or a list. |
| `fileName` | text | `""` | The name a source file is stored under. |
| `actions` | JSON |  | Nested actions: run with each file. |

<a id="action-cloudData"></a>
### `cloudData`: Cloud data

Creates, updates, deletes, reads, queries or aggregates documents of a collection. Its result (the new id, the document, the documents, the number) is the chain's `${result}` and goes in `resultVariable`.

Written `cloudData operation=… collection=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation` | `create` `update` `delete` `get` `query` `count` `sum` `average` | `create` |  |
| `collection` | text | `""` |  |
| `id` | text | `""` |  |
| `fields` | JSON |  | Field writes: [{"field", "value", "operation"}]. |
| `whereFilters` | JSON |  |  |
| `orderByFilters` | JSON |  |  |
| `limit` | whole number |  |  |
| `aggregateField` | text | `""` |  |
| `loadRelated` | list of text | `[]` |  |
| `resultVariable` | text | `""` |  |

<a id="action-cloudBatch"></a>
### `cloudBatch`: Cloud batch

Several `CloudDataAction` writes (create, update, delete) committed at once. With `forEach`, `steps` run once per item of that list (`${loop.item}`, `${loop.index}`), every write in the same commit: "mark all read" in one write instead of one per item.

Written `cloudBatch steps=… transaction=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | JSON |  | Nested cloudData actions. |
| `transaction` | `true`/`false` | `false` | All or none: more than 500 writes fail instead of committing in chunks. |
| `forEach` | text | `""` | A list: the steps run per item (${loop.item}, ${loop.index}), all in one commit. |

<a id="action-submitForm"></a>
### `submitForm`: Submit form

Validates a form's answers and stores them in the app's own variables (`service: local`). See `docs/submit_form.md`.

Written `submitForm service=… payload=…`. Level 5.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `service` | `local` | `local` | Only `local` is offered: `FormService.unsupported` marks old data. |
| `payload` | text | `""` | An expression yielding a JSON object. |
| `validationScript` | text | `""` | Await a script returning {valid, errors?, payload?}. |
| `validationArguments` | JSON |  | Named script argument expressions. |
| `responseVariable` | text | `""` | Optional mutable list variable receiving the validated payload. Persist the variable to keep submissions. |
| `prepend` | `true`/`false` | `false` |  |
| `resultVariable` | text | `""` | An expression yielding a JSON object. An awaited validator may replace it with its normalized `payload`. |
| `onSuccess` | JSON |  |  |
| `onError` | JSON |  |  |

## Examples

<a id="data-example-pages-data-json"></a>
### pages/data.json

From [`pages/data.json`](../data.md).

```notation
canvas h=200
Column#col gap=12 pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":200}
  Text#saved "Saved theme: {storage.theme}" size=15 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":20}
  Button#save "Use dark" style={"backgroundColor":"#FF111827","foregroundColor":"#FFFFFFFF"} w=160 h=44 onTap={setStorage key=theme value=dark; showToast message=Saved style=success}
```
